market_question: Will Thomas Massie be the Republican nominee for KY-04?
reasoning: Thomas Massie is the long-time incumbent in a safe GOP district with no announced primary challenger and no retirement speculation. Incumbent House members who seek renomination historically win primaries over 95% of the time. The market's 48.5% implies nearly even odds, which grossly underestimates his chances.
evidence_points: Incumbent re-nomination rate in House primaries exceeds 95%.
Massie has not drawn a serious primary challenger in recent cycles and easily won unopposed in 2022 and 2024.
